text:
ana-fin: FYI HelioThera flagged their renewal invoice (HT-2026-0610). They say platform fee looks double-counted because there's a separate 'PLATFORM_TRUEUP' line plus the standard platform SKU.

liam-ar: Can you paste the lines? Helio's AP will hold until we clarify.

ana-fin: Snippet from invoice (redacted):
```
Line 8: PLATFORM_STD - $95,000 - SKU PF-ENT-2026
Line 9: PLATFORM_TRUEUP - $20,000 - SKU PF-TP-TRUEUP
Line 10: SUPPORT_TIER_PLATINUM - $40,000 - SKU SUP-PLAT
Total due: $155,000
```
Customer says their SOW lists $115k platform (net). The extra $20k looks like we charged an annual usage true-up on top of platform instead of netting it.

rachel-cs: HelioThera migrated to Dedicated last year and had a consumption true-up clause. We intended to apply the true-up as an adjustment to the platform fee (net), not as an additive line on the face. Which billing rule handled PF-TP-TRUEUP?

billing-bot: Billing run 2026-06-10-03:21 completed. Rule set: true-ups emitted as separate line for SKUs matching PF-TP-*. Generated ticket BILL-7951 for potential customer-facing wording change.

liam-ar: If the true-up was supposed to be netted we need approval evidence to issue a credit memo or reissue. Do we have a signed amendment or a pricing worksheet that shows netting?

ops-maria: Ops note: the PS team submitted an amendment (AMND-HT-2025-09) that says "true-ups offset against committed platform fee where customer opts into netting" and Helio elected netting via signature on 2025-09-12. I can attach the amendment to the account record.

ana-fin: Great. So action: 1) attach AMND-HT-2025-09 to the billing ticket, 2) billing team to either reissue invoice HT-2026-0610 with consolidated platform line "Platform Fee (includes annual true-up per AMND-HT-2025-09)" or issue a credit memo for $20,000, 3) AR to hold posting until corrected.

billing-bot: BILL-7951 assigned to @billing-ops. ETA to reissue: 3 business days. Option set: reissue invoice with consolidated wording + memo referencing AMND-HT-2025-09.

liam-ar: I'll mark AR to expect a corrected invoice and delay cash application until we have it. Please include the internal approval ID in the invoice memo so AP can auto-post.

rachel-cs: I'll email Helio AP with the amendment PDF and confirm they're OK with a corrected invoice vs. credit memo. Heads-up: they asked for invoice language to explicitly state "net of true-up".

ana-fin: Thanks all. Let's keep the thread for updates on BILL-7951. :+1:
notes: HelioThera true-up netting dispute; billing ticket created
